title: mri_ca_normalize
description: This program creates a normalized volume using the brain volume and an input gca file.

input_brain_volumes.description: Input brain volume(s). Can specify multiple inputs.
input_brain_volumes.title: Input Brain Volumes

output_volumes.description: Output volume(s) in either mgh or mgz format. Can specify multiple outputs.
output_volumes.title: Output Volumes

sigma_value.description: Smoothing sigma for bias field if control points specified (default=4).
sigma_value.title: Smoothing Sigma

dilate_iters.description: Dilate the brain mask niters times before masking.
dilate_iters.title: Dilate Iterations

nsamples_file.description: Write transformed normalization control points to filename.
nsamples_file.title: Nsamples File

fonly_file.description: Only use control points from filename.
fonly_file.title: Fonly File

debug_voxel_coords.description: Debug voxel. Needs x, y, z coordinates.
debug_voxel_coords.title: Debug Voxel Coordinates

debug_node_coords.description: Debug node. Needs x, y, z coordinates.
debug_node_coords.title: Debug Node Coordinates

example_mri_vol.description: Use T1 (mri_vol) and segmentation as example.
example_mri_vol.title: Example MRI Volume

extra_norm_pctl.description: Use 1+pct and 1-pct to widen the range of T1 values.
extra_norm_pctl.title: Extra Norm PCT

top_percent.description: Use top p percent (default=.25) white matter points as control points.
top_percent.title: Top Percent

renorm_file.description: Renormalize using predicted intensity values in mri_vol.
renorm_file.title: Renormalize File

flash_flag.description: Use FLASH forward model to predict intensity values.
flash_flag.title: Flash Flag
